why.title: Why this exists
why.quote: “My saved messages had hundreds of links: courses, a coat I wanted, a ramen recipe, that one article about zoneless Angular. I could never find any of them again. So I built the shelf I wanted.”
why.author: Dmytro

built.title: How it's built

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Shelfmark is a personal project that stores the links you save. This page explains what we keep and why, in plain words.

store.title: What we store
store.account: From Google or GitHub: your name, email address and avatar (a link to your profile picture). They are used to sign you in and to show who is signed in. Your account record also holds which provider you used and your id there.
store.content: Your links (address, title, note, favourite mark, when you last opened it), your folders and your tags.
store.images: For each link, a small copy of the site's icon and preview image, if the site has them. Our server downloads and stores them so they load from Shelfmark.
store.feedback: Your answers to the in-app rating, linked to your account: a score from 1 to 10 and, if you write one, a comment.
store.sessions: For each sign-in: when it expires, plus the IP address and the browser (user agent) it was started from, to keep sessions secure.
store.logs: Our API logs the request method, path, status, duration and a request id, without link contents or personal data. Our host, Vercel, keeps its own standard request logs, which include IP addresses, for a limited time.

cookies.title: Cookies and browser storage
cookies.necessary: We use strictly necessary cookies only. A session cookie keeps you signed in, in the demo as well. A short-lived cookie protects the Google and GitHub sign-in flow. They are httpOnly and SameSite=Lax, and Secure on the live site. Signing out removes the session cookie.
cookies.none: There are no advertising, analytics or tracking cookies, and no analytics scripts.
cookies.storage: Your browser's local storage holds interface preferences only: the theme and the cards or list view. They stay in your browser. The installed app (PWA) caches Shelfmark's own files for fast start-up, not your links.

dont.title: What we don't do
dont.sell: We don't sell or share your data and don't show ads.
dont.read: We don't look at your saved links except where needed to run the service, for example to fetch a preview.

previews.title: Link previews
previews.body: When you save a link, our server visits that page to read its title, icon and preview image. The site therefore sees our server's IP address and the user agent "ShelfmarkBot", not your IP address.

third.title: Other services
third.signin: Sign-in goes through Google or GitHub. They receive the fact that you sign in to Shelfmark, and each has its own privacy policy:
third.tokens: We do not store the access tokens that Google or GitHub issue when you sign in.
third.monitoring: If error monitoring is switched on, crashes and server errors are reported to Sentry through our own server. Reports are scrubbed before they leave: no email, IP address, cookies, request contents or saved link addresses, only technical details such as the error type, where in the code it happened, your browser and system type, the page path and a request id. If it is off, nothing is sent.

where.title: Where it lives
where.hosting: The API runs on Vercel in the fra1 region (Frankfurt) and the database on Neon in eu-central-1 (Frankfurt). The app's static files are served from Vercel's global network.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.data: We keep your account and everything in it until you delete it.
retention.sessions: A sign-in lasts 7 days and is extended when you use the app, at most once a day. After that you sign in again.
retention.demo: The demo is a temporary sandbox with sample links. It ends after 24 hours, and a daily cleanup job deletes expired demo accounts with all their data. To limit abuse we keep a one-way hash of the network address that opened the demo, never the address itself, and it is deleted with the demo account.

control.title: Your control
control.export: In Settings you can export your links, folders, tags and notes as JSON or as a browser bookmarks file (HTML).
control.delete: You can delete any link at any time, or delete your whole account in Settings. Your account and all its data are then removed from the database. Backups kept by the database provider may take a short while to expire.

security.title: Security
security.body: Data is sent over HTTPS. Each account can only reach its own data. Sign-in uses Google or GitHub, so we never see or store a password.

children.title: Children
children.body: Shelfmark is not directed at children, and we do not knowingly collect data from them.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: If the way Shelfmark handles data changes, we update this page and its "Last updated" date.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For questions about this policy or your data, open an issue in the GitHub repository.
contact.noPersonal: Issues are public, so please do not put personal data in them.
